articles.summary: In July, Behr Paint Company announced a new nationwide initiative in partnership with the Painting Contractors Association (PCA) to support U.S. veterans and transitioning service members as they begin or grow careers in the professional painting industry. Through this program, 100 veterans will receive a scholarship for a complimentary first-year PCA membership—granting full access to PCA’s robust network of education, training, and business resources. In addition, recipients will be paired with personalized mentors, including PCA member volunteers and members of the Behr Veterans Network. articles.title: Behr Paint Supports Veterans through Industry Partnership
